upstream.license_observation: CMNET2 README says it inherits original yyang181/colormnet license. No independent license classification made here; keep upstream code/weights external until parent verifies rights. DINOv3 and SAM2 have separate terms.

lessons: One OS GPU lock across every render and optional SAM trial; do not kill unrelated user applications.
Hash content, not incidental approval timestamps. Publish reference PNGs atomically before readiness markers. Bounded Windows replace retry handles antivirus/read-lock races.
Contiguous half-open global frame ranges and native batch clip caches prevent repeated decoding from frame zero; never impose the old 4320-frame pilot length on a lecture.
Merge original decoded Y with model UV at native geometry. Independently verify all Y frames, original decoded PCM through natural EOF, native cadence and immutable reuse YUV.
References must be shot-local and materials/view-compatible. Inspect actual source-Y recombined guides: visually plausible generated RGB can contain moved face/hand geometry.
Avoid artificial propagation breaks inside one pan/zoom; combine propagation, preserve canonical crop mapping.
Measure original source transition windows. Use actual per-frame fields from both scenes before source-alpha composition; held endpoint UV failed on moving towers, people and close faces.

Scientific-photo neutrality must apply to each scene hypothesis before dissolves, with source-aligned foreground/pointer exclusions and explicit outgoing handles. A screen polygon alone neutralizes the lecturer.
SAM temporal trials still need dense native source QA; shadows, pale cloth, fingers, pointers and camera cuts need bounded source-contour corrections.

Full source-UV scientific protection, actor exclusion and exact chroma-outside-support proof are separate gates from visual quality. Intermediate mask guarantees must not be misrepresented as final-composite guarantees.
Version every attempt and correction. Resume only exact-hash verified completed outputs; rejection receipts must prevent stale overrides from reentering selection.
Rolling cleanup may delete only exact obsolete work media after replacement proof and active-handle checks; retain provenance and a reserve plus measured allowance.

For daily ~10-minute batches, stop at a natural reviewed boundary, preflight geometry/references before GPU time, and resume from immutable completed attempts. Human/scoped QA remains a real workload.
abandoned_as_production_methods: Held-endpoint dissolve UV for moving geometry
Blind six-frame transition windows without source inspection
Single fixed screen polygon without actor/shadow discrimination
Sparse long-step affine board tracking; broad convex actor hole fill
Raw SAM foreground automatically treated as truth
Global or rectangular hue replacement across unknown physical materials
